snippet.title: Mota Must Die - VAINSANE Fridays #3
snippet.description:
VAINSANE Fridays #3 — Mota Must Die

A short psychological visual novel where you interrogate a friend accused of murder...

Part of VAINSANE Fridays, where I release a new bite-sized horror game every other Friday. Releasing on April 10, 2026.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4533400/Mota_Must_Die/
